name: opencode-annotate
description: Annotate webpages in Chrome and send screenshots + element context to your OpenCode session. Works on OpenCode 1 and OpenCode 2. Fork of JodusNodus/opencode-chrome-annotation.

scripts.check:extension: npm run build:extension && node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/injected/dom.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8'))"
scripts.icons:generate: sips -s format png -z 16 16 icon.svg --out extension/icons/icon16.png && sips -s format png -z 48 48 icon.svg --out extension/icons/icon48.png && sips -s format png -z 128 128 icon.svg --out extension/icons/icon128.png
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build:v1 && (cd v2 && node --test) && node --check server.js && node --check v2/index.js && node --test hybrid.test.js
scripts.publish: node -e "if (process.env.npm_command === 'publish') process.exit(0); require('child_process').execSync('npm publish --access public', { stdio: 'inherit' });"

author: Benjamin Shafii
